name: ossify
description: Skeleton-first lifecycle from Release 0 through MVP and v1. A replacement for scaffold-onboard + scaffold-dev, not a stage alongside them. Requires workspace-init: /ossify:start refuses without its pairing manifest. Self-sufficient: the grill and the adversarial critic ship in-tree as /ossify:challenge, with a configurable external adversary (OSSIFY_ADVERSARY). /ossify:start does the pre-code spec-core onboarding, /ossify:adopt onboards an existing codebase, /ossify:plan-release opens a release, /ossify:plan-spine lays out its skeleton, /ossify:run-spine drives the rounds, /ossify:close runs the close ceremony, /ossify:doctor diagnoses state, spec, rules, interop and budgets, plus the any-repo /ossify:handoff and /ossify:work-pr.
